company.name: MelSpectrum
company.legal_zh: 融谱智能科技（深圳）有限公司

marks.company: dome (sound) with an inner negative-space M, dissolving into five staff stripes (spectrum / 五线谱 / 融)
marks.pianotuner: seven curved arms (seven white keys of an octave) radiating from a struck centre — a pinwheel of sound

display.use: >=64 CSS px: OG, JSON-LD logo 512, print

micro.use: <=23 px: favicon 16/24; company micro has no inner M

appicon.use: iOS single-size 1024 optical master (system derives every Home/Settings/Spotlight size) and apple-touch-icon 180

appIcon.treatment: T1: teal #14B8A6 background, white #FAFAFA mark, coverage 0.56 of canvas
appIcon.rule: source artwork stays square; never bake the system mask into the raster

rules: Pick the master by the final perceived size on the surface, never by the output raster size.
Never scale the display master down to favicon size; use micro/standard.
Marks are single-colour: teal on light, tealDark on dark, white on brand-colour ground. Somnil uses its own violet.
No gradients, no shadows, no glow; the iOS Clear/Tinted appearances are produced by the system from the same artwork.
